question.title: Amendment No. 2: Use Of Marijuana For Debilitating Medical Conditions

source.name: Florida Department of State, Division of Elections, full text of the measure (PDF linked "View Full Text" on the detail page); read in full, searched for tax, fee, levy, assess, licen*, revenue, charge, fine, penalt*

ballot_text.source_title: Ballot Number 2, Election Year 2016: Use of Marijuana for Debilitating Medical Conditions
ballot_text.type_quote: hereby petition the Secretary of State to place the following proposed amendment to the Florida Constitution on the ballot in the general election

fact.quote: The Department of Health shall register and regulate centers that produce and distribute marijuana for medical purposes and shall issue identification cards to patients and caregivers.
fact.why: Citizen-initiative text of Art. X, s. 29 (read in full): it removes liability for medical use and directs the Department of Health to issue rules, ID cards and treatment-center registrations; no word in it imposes or sets a tax or fee. The Financial Impact Estimating Conference statement linked from the DOS page (fiec_2016_a2.txt) says "Fees may offset some of the regulatory costs. Sales tax will likely apply to most purchases", which describes consequences under general law and later rules, not a tax or fee the amendment imposes. A close call with 2024 No. 3; inferred.

source.name: Florida Department of State, Division of Elections, Initiatives / Amendments / Revisions Database, detail page "Tax Exemption for Totally and Permanently Disabled First Responders"
